Name: Ahi, Son of Abdiel
Summary: Son of Abdiel son of Guni, chief of the house of Gad's fathers.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 5:15: Son of Abdiel son of Guni, chief of the house of Gad's fathers.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ahi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
